title: What one row lets presolve conclude
heading: Activity Bounds Prove a Row Redundant or Fix a Variable
cases: a row whose most activity is within the right-hand side is redundant and fixes nothing
a free 0-1 variable whose coefficient alone overruns the row is fixed at 0
a variable already fixed at 1 counts in the least activity, so it can force others to 0
when even the least activity overruns the right-hand side, the verdict is infeasible
a variable with a negative coefficient is fixed at 1 when 0 would overrun the row
a row whose most activity is above the right-hand side only by rounding is kept, not deleted
